newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bosch headlight production leaves Germany.
newsitem.headline: Bosch headlight production leaves Germany.

text.p: Robert Bosch GmbH, citing a need to lower costs, said on Monday it would shift part of its headlight manufacturing from Germany to the neighbouring Czech Republic over the next four years.
Bosch planned to move the work done by some 450 employees in Reutlingen to a subsidiary in the Czech city of Jihlava by the end of the year 2000.
"The products can no longer be made in Germany at competitive prices because of rising competition," Bosch said.

About 270 of the affected workers would stay on in other areas of the Reutlingen plant, which also produces reflectors and tools. Bosch will try to offer the other 180 positions in other plants near Stuttgart, the company said.
Bosch employs 5,000 workers at Reutlingen, the technical centre of its lighting business. It also produces headlights in Brotterode in eastern Germany, in Malaysia and at a joint venture in Russia.
